name: Possession
overview: Scripture reveals that possession encompasses both spiritual and material realities, including demon possession as seen in Mark 5:1 and Acts 16:16, where individuals were controlled by unclean spirits. Believers are called to stand firm in God's strength and resist the devil, as encouraged in Ephesians 6:10 and James 4:7, highlighting the spiritual battle involved in possession. Additionally, Jude 1:6 reminds us of the eternal judgment reserved for fallen angels who abandoned their proper place, underscoring the seriousness of spiritual rebellion connected to possession.
